category_title: Defiant and disengaged boys who resist standard classroom requirements
scenario_title: Initial classroom entry and independent reading
minimal_context: The student arrives late to class and is directed to a seat in the back to review rules and take out a book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come in and take the empty seat in the back.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks in a few minutes after the bell, looking confident and defiant.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are reviewing the classroom rules right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands confidently and defiantly, looking like trouble.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down and take out a book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains confident and defiant, looking like trouble and beginning to disrupt the class instead of taking out a book.)
